- $a-1$ copies of 2

- $b$ copies of 2

Total weight (sum of arguments) = $2(a-1) + 3 + 2(c-1) + 1 + 2b = 2a - 2 + 3 + 2c - 2 + 1 + 2b = 2a + 2b + 2c$.
So the weight is $2(a+b+c)$.
